summary: Split tally/reports.py into the tally/reports/ package (errors, tables, state, system, formatting, model, loading, aggregate, renderers, cli) following docs/refactoring.md; all files are under 400 lines, imports are layered and acyclic, and the unit tests pass with the three mock.patch targets updated. About 2,100 CLI runs (formats, options, locales, bad inputs) gave identical stdout, stderr and exit status against the original; the only difference is the file paths and line numbers in Python tracebacks of uncaught exceptions.
